-- checks if a given value is in an array
-- returns true if it finds the value, false otherwise
local function checkEntry(t, val)
	for i, v in ipairs(t) do
		if v == val then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- removes all occurrences of a value in an array
-- returns true if at least one occurrence was remove, false otherwise
local function removeEntry(t, val)
	local existed = false
	for i = #t, 1, -1 do
		if t[i] == val then
			tremove(t, i)
			existed = true
		end
	end
	return existed
end

no one reads the release notes :(  
  
I changed DBM to use Master channel as most addon authors did. But i actually added an option in the addon to disable master channel usage and still go through SFX channel. But keep in mind DBM always used master volume until blizzard broke it in 4.0.1.
This is not something we just mindlessly threw in there. There were iiterally hundreds of complaints that 4.0.1 made dbm sounds hard to hear over noisey sound effects, or unable to have dbm sounds when game sounds were off. Using the master channel firstly enables you to have addon sounds even if you turn regular sound effects off, and secondly, makes sure you can hear an addon alert sound over your reduced SFX volume, so a priests portal sound for example cover up an important sound event.  
  
The fact that it's TOO loud has nothing to do with dbm and everything to do with you blasting your computer speakers cause your game isn't configured properly. It just means you have your game sounds turned so low that you over crank your speakers. What you need to do is turn those speakers down, and turn SFX up. or if you don't like dbm using master channel, just click the checkbox in options, it's that simple.
here is a quote from DBM notes which were right on curse download page and homepage main page right on top.  
  
"Now supports playing sound files through "Master" sound channel (making dbm basically function as it did in 3.3.5 with sounds.)  
Added option to disable "Master" channel usage though in case some have gotten used to sounds going through SFX channel since 4.0.1"

I cannot keep the files on here updated. It's something i've complained about in past that co authors besides having their name listed literally have 0 project control :(  
  
EDIT. Oh wow I stand corrected, i can manage files now heh. Well then, it's my bad it's sorely out of date on here. I'll fix that immediately!

Plays the specified audio file once. Unlike PlayMusic , you cannot stop the playback.

```
PlaySoundFile("path"[, "channel"])
```

## Contents

* 1 Arguments
* 2 Examples
* 3 Notes
* 4 See also

## Arguments [ ]

path
    String – The path and name of the sound file you'd like to play, relative to the WoW directory; both ogg and mp3 formats are accepted. The file must exist prior to logging in to WoW.
channel
    String – Either "Master" (this will play the sound also with disabled sounds like before 4.0.1), "SFX", "Ambience", "Music".

## Examples [ ]

You can play a sound file included with your addon:

```
PlaySoundFile("Interface\\AddOns\\MyAddOn\\mysound.ogg")
```

Or one of the ones shipped with WoW ( Power of the Horde , in this case):

```
PlaySoundFile("Sound\\Music\\ZoneMusic\\DMF_L70ETC01.mp3")
```

## Notes [ ]

* There does not appear to be a bad error if the file is missing - it just won't play. There is a return status, which is 1 if the sound was OK and nil if it couldn't be found.
* This API call was broken in patch 1.11 and was fixed in patch 1.11.2.
* As of 4.0.1, custom .wav files are no longer supported.

## See also [ ]

* PlaySoundFile macros for a listing of audio files shipped with the game.
